scripts.test:daily: node scripts/preserve-allure-history.js && node scripts/preserve-failure-summary.js && npm run clean:reports && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=chromium && npm run allure:generate && npm run reports:archive
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.setup:browsers: npx playwright install chromium firefox webkit
scripts.clean: rimraf reports/allure-results reports/allure-report reports/diagnostics reports/walkthrough reports/html-report reports/test-results reports/test-results.json reports/failure-summary.json reports/junit-results.xml logs/test-execution.log
scripts.clean:reports: rimraf reports/html-report reports/allure-results reports/allure-report reports/test-results reports/test-results.json reports/failure-summary.json reports/junit-results.xml && node scripts/ensure-report-dirs.js
scripts.build:framework: node -e "console.error('ERROR: framework build is not run from this package. Contact the QA automation team for framework updates.'); process.exit(1)"
